learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the content of electronic defense and warfare.
Learning basic RADAR techniques and system design.
Learning about Radio Frequency (RF) propagation, antennas, transmitters, receivers, and sensors.
Learning about tactical communication systems, information warfare, electronic attack and protection, electronic listening, and electronic support measures.

Gaining knowledge about high-power RF energy weapons, electromagnetic invisibility technology, frequency selective surface, RF jammers, microwave and millimeter-wave RADARs, over-the-horizon high-frequency RADAR, ground-penetrating RADAR (GPR), passive RADAR, infrared (IR) sensors, and acoustic underwater RADAR (SONAR).
